title: Detecting and Controlling Sycophancy with Cascading Linear Features
reasoning: The paper focuses on the mechanistic interpretability of sycophancy in LLMs, specifically identifying cascading linear features in activation space. While it uses the ELEPHANT scorer, it explicitly excludes the 'moral endorsement' dimension in its evaluation, and its primary focus is on the behavioral alignment pathology of sycophancy rather than evaluating religion, faith, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
